$comment: Fables Stage 1 complete build. Extends spec/disclaimers.v1.json. FIXED strings reproduced verbatim. BUILDER_DRAFT strings completed per spec notes. Voice short-form word count checked: 24 words (limit 40). Plain-English target Year 8. Tokens {{...}} resolve at Stage 5. For legal-firm sign-off.

rules: Use only 'general information', 'common pattern', 'usually understood', 'often considered' framing for fault content.
Never state or imply a conclusion about the user's specific case ('you are/aren't at fault', 'they will pay').
Never output a numeric fault percentage or split assigned to the user's case.
Never name unverified case law in customer-facing text.
Every fault-information output attaches disclaimer key 'master' (voice: 'master_voice_short' permitted after first full read in same session).
Plain English, target reading level Year 8; any legal term used must be explained inline.
Persona never expresses an opinion; deflect direct advice requests using utterance category (e) then offer lawyer callback.

master.context: Shown on every screen displaying fault information; read on every voice call before first fault-information output.
master.text: What I'm about to share is general information about how these types of accidents are usually understood under NSW road rules — it is not legal advice, and it does not determine who is legally at fault. Only your insurer, a lawyer, or a court can do that. A lawyer will review your full situation.

master_voice_short.context: Repeat-use voice form after master has been read once in the session. Word count: 24. Limit 40. All four mandatory elements present: (1) general information, (2) not legal advice, (3) does not determine fault, (4) lawyer will review.
master_voice_short.text: Just to remind you — this is general information, not legal advice, and it doesn't determine who's at fault. A lawyer will review your situation.

pdf_footer.context: Footer of every customer PDF summary.
pdf_footer.text: This summary was generated by an AI assistant and has not been reviewed by a lawyer. It is for your records only.

sms_constraint.context: Rule, not a string: SMS bodies contain no legal or fault content — links and logistics only.

recording_consent.context: Read at start of every voice call, before any other content. Includes purpose (quality and legal) and a consent confirmation step. Base wording from Loop Request preserved.
recording_consent.text: This call may be recorded for quality and legal purposes. The recording helps {{FIRM_NAME}} assist you and is handled under the Privacy Act 1988. If you'd prefer not to be recorded, you can continue without recording, but please note that some options may be limited. Do you consent to the call being recorded? Please say yes or no.

privacy_notice.context: Presented before any PII is collected, all channels. References Privacy Act 1988, Australian-region storage, retention {{RETENTION_PERIOD}}, and who can access ({{FIRM_NAME}}, panel shop staff where applicable). Web <= 120 words; voice version is a separate string.

text.web: How we handle your information. {{FIRM_NAME}} collects the details you give us so we can take your accident report, arrange practical help, and prepare a brief for the lawyer who will call you back. We handle your information under the Privacy Act 1988 and store it in Australia. We keep your record for {{RETENTION_PERIOD}}, after which it is securely destroyed. The people who can see your information are staff at {{FIRM_NAME}} and, where needed, panel shop staff helping with your tow or repair. We do not sell your information. You can ask to see or correct what we hold at any time.
text.voice: Quick note on privacy. {{FIRM_NAME}} will handle your details under the Privacy Act 1988 and store them in Australia for {{RETENTION_PERIOD}}. Staff at {{FIRM_NAME}}, and panel shop staff if they help with your tow or repair, are the only people who will see them. You can ask to see or correct your details at any time. Okay to continue?

state_scope_guard.context: When user indicates accident occurred outside NSW.
state_scope_guard.text: I can only provide general information about New South Wales road rules. Your accident happened in a different state, so I won't guess — I'll take your details and make sure a lawyer who can help calls you back.

escalation_handoff.context: Spoken/shown when a global escalation trigger fires. One variant per trigger category. All variants: acknowledge, not alarm, explain a human will take over, state callback expectation token {{CALLBACK_SLA}}. Wording is neutral — never accuses.

injury.voice: I'm sorry to hear that. Because an injury has been reported, I'm going to stop the questions and bring a human in straight away. {{FIRM_NAME}} will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}}. Please don't move from a safe spot if you can, and if anything changes, call 000.
injury.web: An injury has been reported in your case. We're routing this to a human at {{FIRM_NAME}} immediately — they will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}}. If the situation is urgent, please call 000.
injury.use_when: esc-injury fires (minor or serious; serious routes immediately, minor after safety check)

dispute_fraud.voice: Thanks for letting me know. What you've said is important, and I want to make sure a human reviews it carefully. {{FIRM_NAME}} will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}}.
dispute_fraud.web: Thanks for raising that. We're routing this to a human at {{FIRM_NAME}} for a closer look — they will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}}.
dispute_fraud.use_when: esc-dispute or esc-fraud fires. Wording is deliberately neutral; the system does not accuse any party.

advice.voice: That's a question for a lawyer, not for me — and I don't want to give you the wrong impression. {{FIRM_NAME}} will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}} to go through it properly.
advice.web: That's a question for a lawyer, not for an AI assistant. We're routing this to a human at {{FIRM_NAME}} — they will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}}.
advice.use_when: esc-advice fires. Deflection is via persona utterance category (e) first; this handoff follows the offer to callback.

complexity.voice: This one's a bit more involved than I can talk through safely. {{FIRM_NAME}} will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}} to go through it with you.
complexity.web: This case is more involved than an AI can handle confidently. We're routing it to a human at {{FIRM_NAME}} — they will be in touch within {{CALLBACK_SLA}}.
complexity.use_when: esc-hitrun, esc-vulnerable, esc-multiparty, or scenario-level escalation override fires.

session_close.context: CLOSE state: reference number readback, what happens next, disclaimer confirmation. Voice and web variants.

variants.voice: You're all done. Your reference number is [ref]. Here's what happens next: a lawyer from {{FIRM_NAME}} will call you back within {{CALLBACK_SLA}} during {{BUSINESS_HOURS}}. You'll get an SMS with a link to a summary of what we've recorded. And just to be clear — what we discussed today is general information, not legal advice, and a lawyer will review your full situation. Take care.
variants.web: Your reference number is [ref]. A lawyer from {{FIRM_NAME}} will contact you within {{CALLBACK_SLA}} during {{BUSINESS_HOURS}}. We've sent you an SMS with a link to a PDF summary. Remember: this conversation is general information, not legal advice, and a lawyer will review your full situation.

pd_recovery_disclosure.context: PD intake consent-gate disclosure (PD-COUNSEL-MEMO-2026-07-14.md §3.2). Presented to the consumer BEFORE consent is recorded when the intake is for property_damage. Two audit events fire: pd_disclosure_presented (when the gate renders) and pd_disclosure_acknowledged (when the consumer accepts, sibling to consent_granted). Defeats the sector's 'I wasn't told' ACL complaint.
pd_recovery_disclosure.text:
Important — please read before you continue.

{{OPERATOR_NAME}} helps you, the not-at-fault driver, recover the cost of your vehicle repairs, a like-for-like hire vehicle, and towing from the at-fault driver or their insurer. We do this as your recovery agent, on your instructions. You remain the owner of your claim. This means:

• You are the principal. Any recovery is made in your name. If the matter settles, the payment comes to you (less our agreed fee, which we tell you before you agree to anything).
• If the at-fault driver or their insurer disputes the claim, court proceedings — if they become necessary — would be brought in your name, conducted by a lawyer you instruct. You would be the plaintiff. That carries a potential cost risk: in the rare event a court found against you, you could be liable for some of the other side's costs.
• Your credit record could be affected if a disputed matter is not resolved.

We will tell you at every step what is happening and what your options are. You can stop at any time. If at any point we think you should get independent legal advice, we will tell you so.

This service is not legal advice, and {{OPERATOR_NAME}} is not a law firm.
